svg.text: Vite bundle served by the Worker. Live task feed, evidence viewer,
Session Replay and browser source maps uploaded on every build.
Every phase persists before the alarm returns, so a restart resumes mid-run instead of starting over.
An unavailable service is retried three times, then the task pauses rather than inventing a result.
Four models, four research strategies, separate tool budgets — one provider, so this is strategy diversity, not model-family independence.
Audits every number, date and unit
Each seller runs the Responses API with web search and returns a verdict, per-sub-claim answers, sources and exact quotes. 2–4 are staffed per task. Nothing they say is trusted yet.
Runs server-side, outside the agents’ control. Deterministic code, no model in the loop.
Fetch every cited URL, extract text, hash it, index it
Quote must reach 0.75 three-gram containment in that page
Strip seller identity, sort sources, shuffle review order
page real, quote absent — no credit
403 or PDF — not held against the seller
A 404 is fraud; a 403 or a PDF is infrastructure. Separating the two is why honest sellers still get paid.
Reviewers never see who produced the submission, or what anyone else concluded.
consensus, or a structured tiebreak when they disagree
every hard check must pass — at least one verifiable citation, no fabricated source, no unsupported claim
Credit is pro-rata across the sub-claims, so a partly-correct answer is partly paid.
Lamports transfer to that seller slot
Nothing moves; the buyer keeps the amount
One transaction per seller slot. The memo carries the hash of the verification that authorised it.
the chain records the decision, it does not enforce it

g.text: One distributed trace per task · spans stitched across alarm restarts
